1) <Settings | Privacy & Security | Junk | When messages are marked as junk | Move them to the account’s “Junk” folder>

...and to override that default on a per-account basis,

<Account Settings | (the account in question) | Junk Settings | Move new junk messages to | (define destionation)>

2) The filters do work, as millions of users could attest. They work quite well for me. If you show us one maybe we can find whatever it is you're doing wrong.

3) How would you like us to respond to a rant like that? Thunderbird's Adaptive Junk Filter is not "AI" as it is considered today, it's a trainable Bayesian filter that works as trainable Bayesian filters have always worked, and it works very well for me. If you don't like it, it can be turned off. You're certainly under on obligation to use it.
